description: This file defines a LicenseKeyService class for managing license key validation and usage incrementing, including caching and environment-based bypasses. It also includes a Noop implementation and a singleton accessor.

classes.name: LicenseKeyService
classes.description: Handles license key validation, usage increment, and caching logic.

classes.name: NoopLicenseKeyService
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of ILicenseKeyService for testing or bypass.

classes.name: LicenseKeySingleton
classes.description: Singleton pattern for managing a single instance of ILicenseKeyService.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a LicenseKeyService instance based on deployment repository.

methods.name: fetcher
methods.description: Performs HTTP fetch with nonce and signature headers, with timeout.

methods.name: validateLicenseKey
methods.description: Static method to validate a license key directly, bypassing in E2E mode.

methods.name: incrementUsage
methods.description: Increments license usage for a specified event.

methods.name: checkLicense
methods.description: Checks license validity, with caching and environment bypass.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of license key service.
